### Executed Code:
```python
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from pyscf import gto, dft
import numpy as np
s='CN1C=CCC1=O'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(s))
status=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,randomSeed=17)
if status != 0: raise RuntimeError('3D embedding failed')
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m)
conf=m.GetConformer()
atoms=[a.GetSymbol() for a in m.GetAtoms()]
coords=np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])
atomstr=';'.join(f'{a} {x:.8f} {y:.8f} {z:.8f}' for a,(x,y,z) in zip(atoms,coords))
mol=gto.M(atom=atomstr,basis='def2-SVP',unit='Angstrom',charge=0,spin=0,verbose=0)
calc=dft.RKS(mol); calc.xc='B3LYP'; calc.conv_tol=1e-10
energy=calc.kernel()
occ=calc.mo_occ > 0
homo=float(calc.mo_energy[occ][-1]); lumo=float(calc.mo_energy[~occ][0])
print('Decoded SMILES:',s)
print('Method: B3LYP/def2-SVP, RKS; RDKit MMFF geometry optimization')
print('SCF converged:',calc.converged,'Total energy (Ha):',energy)
print('HOMO (Ha):',homo,'LUMO (Ha):',lumo,'Gap (Ha):',lumo-homo)
```
